result.title: Spectral Uncertainty Decomposition for Sparse Bayesian Learning
result.summary: Estimating distributed neural sources from M/EEG measurements is an ill-posed inverse problem where principled uncertainty quantification remains challenging. The usual conditional Gaussian posterior covariance does not explicitly distinguish uncertainty along likelihood-visible source directions from uncertainty that is invisible to the measurements. We propose a spectral framework based on the singular value structure of the prior-preconditioned forward operator, which provides an exact, interpretable decomposition of the posterior covariance into data-informed and indeterminacy epistemic components. This formulation identifies uncertainty contributions that are reducible by better measurements from those that are fundamentally irreducible by sensing geometry. We further derive an equivalent subtractive decomposition that expresses the prior covariance as the sum of posterior and data-driven reduction terms, enabling precise accounting of uncertainty reduction through Bayesian learning. Together, these complementary representations offer both theoretical insight and practical tools for interpretable uncertainty quantification in M/EEG source imaging for linear-Gaussian Bayesian inverse solvers where the posterior covariance is available in closed form.

AI.brief_summary: 针对 M/EEG 源成像的病态逆问题，提出基于先验预条件前向算子奇异值结构的谱分解框架，将后验协方差精确拆为「数据可约束」与「不可辨识」两类不确定性分量，并给出等价的减法式分解以核算贝叶斯学习带来的不确定性下降。
AI.relevance_reason: 「可观测方向 vs 感知几何不可约方向」的不确定性拆分，可能为分析 LVR 内部状态中由视觉证据确定与由先验主导的 latent 维度提供概念类比，可供核查其能否用于视觉证据使用与信息坍缩的诊断。
